adjudication.depicted_input: Cell2Text architecture showing single-cell RNA-seq profiles encoded into gene embeddings, projected by a modality adapter, and concatenated with instruction embeddings and prompt embeddings before the language model decoder during fine-tuning.
adjudication.rationale: Figure 1 directly depicts the actual model-input pathway for this paper: single-cell RNA-seq profiles are transformed through the cell encoder and adapter into projected gene embeddings, which are concatenated with instruction and prompt embeddings and fed to the language model decoder. Under the atlas rules, a shared architecture figure can support named variants from the same paper when the depicted input mechanism is the same, so the absence of a visible 'Llama-1B' label does not invalidate the crop. The current crop already includes the relevant input object, representation, transformation, and immediate decoder interface for both supported routes.
